title: The Claude read-only Bash gate refuses `cmp`, a pure file comparator, so read-only reviewers and evaluators fall back to hashing
outcome: The Claude read-only Bash gate refuses `cmp`, a pure file comparator, so read-only reviewers and evaluators fall back to hashing
acceptance: `cmp` is on CLAUDE_READ_ONLY_BASH_COMMANDS (src/claude.rs), and a test through the full read-only permission classifier shows a read-only Claude delegation may run `cmp a b`, `cmp -s a b` and `cmp a b | cat`; the read-only refusal builder no longer names `cmp` as a disallowed command.
The same test shows `cmp a b > f`, `cmp a b >> f` and `cmp a b; touch f` are still refused, and `git hash-object` (with or without -w or --stdin) stays refused.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.

completion.summary: Read-only Claude delegations may now run `cmp`. It is on CLAUDE_READ_ONLY_BASH_COMMANDS, and the refusal messages no longer name it. Redirection, chaining and `git hash-object` stay refused, and a test through the full read-only classifier covers both sides. Committed as d95eae8 and landed in train 22 as merge d2d4680 onto b1d876f. Gate test-e0745d01 passed and was credited (a8cf944d); train gate test-08e23ef6 passed. Review pair clean; evaluation 2831a788 passed 3/3.
